scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.check: npm run migration:check && npm run env:check && npm run deployment:check && npm run secrets:check && npm run check:backend && npm test && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.production:check: npm run install:all && npm run check && npm --prefix backend audit --omit=dev --audit-level=moderate && npm --prefix frontend audit --omit=dev --audit-level=moderate
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm --prefix backend audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm --prefix frontend audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci
